summary: Iter 133 — Logistics Phase 2 (Dispatch Lifecycle) full backend + frontend testing complete. All 23 pytest cases pass (allocate, load, transit, deliver, exception, stock-moves, full, phase-2 lists, phase-1 regression). Frontend Playwright verified: all 3 new routes render (in-transit, deliveries, exceptions), sidebar has 3 new nav items, DR list has dr-open-{id} link, detail page fully renders with all 5 action buttons and populated Vehicle Allocation, Loading Events, POD, Transit Exceptions, and Transit Timeline sections from real Phase 2 seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase 1 does not expose GET /api/logistics/dispatch-requests/{id} (returns 405). The Phase 2 /full endpoint compensates, but a single-resource GET would be conventional. Test suite uses /full to work around this.

site_engineer role does not have 'dispatch_requests' write permission — expired-vehicle/driver blocking guard returns 403 (permission) before it can return 400 (business rule). Guard still functions correctly under the admin/super_admin flow with fitness/insurance/license expiry checks.
seed_data_creation: Tests create disposable TEST_ prefixed vehicles/drivers/DRs; several full-lifecycle DRs (approved→allocated→loaded→in_transit→delivered→closed) now exist in preview DB for demoing the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 lifecycle collections: logistics_vehicle_allocations, logistics_loading_events, logistics_transit_events, logistics_delivery_confirmations, logistics_transit_exceptions, logistics_stock_moves. Sequence prefixes ALC / LOAD / POD / EXC all use YYYY-0000 format. /api/logistics/dispatch-requests/{id}/full is the canonical single-DR GET.
